metadata.description: Skills by Zave Greene for Claude Code and other agents

plugins.name: deslop
plugins.description: Delete-first review of a diff: cut the structure the request did not need before anyone reviews it.

plugins.name: teach-diff
plugins.description: Turn a pull request or diff into an interactive HTML lesson with quizzes and a testing defense.

plugins.name: pr-explainer
plugins.description: Plain-English PR descriptions: what it is, the problem, the fix, where to look, and real evidence it works.

plugins.name: feedback
plugins.description: Click-to-annotate any HTML page, export the notes as a prompt, and have your agent apply them.

plugins.name: edge-case
plugins.description: Use what you built like a real user, hunt the edge cases that break it, and prove each fix.

plugins.name: connector-eval-env
plugins.description: See what your AI integration is doing, test failure scenarios, and inspect the evidence.

plugins.name: taste
plugins.description: Build your own taste skill from the UI corrections you keep making, then hold every render to it.
